entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. To direct your call, please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Order Status'.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, I need to make a return for an order I received about two weeks ago. Order number is VF-8675309.
Certainly. Let me pull up that order for you. VF-8675309... I see it here. It looks like you ordered the Aero Pro jersey and the VeloFit Pulse heart rate monitor. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. I need to return both of them.
Okay, I can definitely help you with that. I see the delivery was made 15 days ago. I can start the return process for the jersey right away; it's well within our 30-day return window.
Great. What about the heart rate monitor?

This is where it gets a little tricky. It seems these two items fall under separate policies. For electronic devices like the Pulse monitor, we have a 14-day return window for hygiene and safety reasons.
Wait, what? It's been 15 days. You're telling me I can't return it because of one single day?

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry for the confusion. The policy for electronics is stricter than for apparel. Since it's just past the 14-day mark, the system won't let me process the return for the Pulse.
That's completely unacceptable. I bought them together! Nobody explained there were different rules for each item. This is ridiculous.
I truly do understand, and you're right to be upset. It's a frustrating situation. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I look at your account and see if there's anything I can do. One moment.
Thank you for holding. I've reviewed your account, and I can see you're a long-time VeloFit VIP member. We really value your loyalty.
I would hope so. I've spent a lot of money here.

And we appreciate it. Given your status and the fact that it is just one day over the policy, I'm going to make a one-time exception for you. I will override the system and approve the return for both the jersey and the Pulse monitor.
Oh! Really? You can do that?

Yes. For our best customers, we can be a bit more flexible. I've just processed the return for both items. I'm emailing you a single, prepaid shipping label right now. You can just box them up together and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's... thank you so much. I was really getting frustrated there. I really appreciate you helping me out.

Of course! It's my pleasure to help. We want to make sure you're happy with your VeloFit experience. You should see that email in the next few minutes. Once we receive your return, a full refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again, Alex. You really turned this around.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
